test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We have requested Mrs Nagpal _______ our play for this year’s annual function.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'to direct.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence the infinite '*to direct*' is the correct choice to fill.
 
• We need a **direct object **for the **verb **(*requested*) in the given sentence. So we will use the infinite form of the verb '**to direct**.'
 
 
• Example: *They asked me **to bring **some food.*
 
 
 
• Thus *option 2 *is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: *We have requested Mrs Nagpal **to direct** our play for this year’s annual function.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's learn more about the **infinitives**:

 
 
• The infinitives act as *a noun, adjective, *or *adverb*, and it is actually made up of two words, **to + verb**. These two words act together as a **noun**, an **adjective**, or an **adverb**. 

 
 
• Example: 

 
 
• *I love **to swim***. (as a **noun**)
 
• *The person **to call **is Jeff*. (as an **adjective**)
 
• *I can't wait **to see **him*. (as an **adverb**)
